buildCommand: if [ "$VERCEL_ENV" = "production" ] && [ -n "$DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED" ]; then echo 'Applying pending Prisma migrations...' && prisma migrate deploy --schema=../../packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma; else echo 'Skipping migrate deploy (non-prod or DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED unset)'; fi && prisma generate --schema=../../packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma && next build
